name: Fire 21 Pizza
tagline: Subs, pizza, pasta and salads in Conway Village, NH. A local favorite since 1979.
seo_title: Fire 21 Pizza | Subs, Pizza, Pasta & Salads in Conway Village, NH Since 1979
seo_desc: Fire 21 Pizza, 7 West Main St, Conway Village NH. Subs, pizza, pasta and salads, serving Conway since 1979 and reopened in August 2018. Call (603) 447-2211.
about: Fire 21 was started in 1979 by Conway native Walter Henderson, who ran it for 25 years. A protégé then ran it for 13 years.
After retiring from Kennett High School in June 2018, Walter took the restaurant back with his wife Jocelyn and son Nico. After a renovation, Fire 21 reopened on August 28, 2018.
Come in for the subs, pizza, pasta and salads that put Fire 21 on the map.
menu_note: Fire 21 serves subs, pizza, pasta and salads. The shop has not published a menu online, so call for items and prices.
